golfops: Golf Participation and Revenue Summaries

Source: R/golfops-package.R
golfops-package.Rd

Summarizes municipal golf participation, daylight-estimated utilization, and revenue for City of Mesa Dobson Ranch. Operating charts use one documented daily sample. Revenue ratios are historical relationships, and tournament results are break-even baselines. Forecasts of observed rounds are not latent demand and not price elasticities. Labeled synthetic examples cover a tournament ticket series and one municipal tee sheet.
